column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for retention/influence records (e.g., 'RET001').
An enum (ChurnRisk_enum) capturing churn risk (High, Medium, Low, None).
A SMALLINT how many times the fan reactivated after inactivity (e.g., 2).
A SMALLINT number of referrals the fan made (e.g., 3).
An INT measuring content reach or audience size (e.g., 500).
A SMALLINT how many viral posts or content pieces the fan created (e.g., 1).
A SMALLINT times the fan participated in trending topics or challenges (e.g., 4).
A SMALLINT count of hashtags the fan used (e.g., 10).
